description: RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 MUST: 'Within this profile, the minimum and maximum fields are not used with any name forms, thus minimum MUST be zero, maximum MUST be absent.' The implementation never checks these fields — it uses only GeneralSubtree.base. A cert with minimum=1 or maximum=5 in a subtree entry is accepted silently and the constraint is applied as if minimum=0. This could lead to constraint bypass or unexpected behavior if a CA issues such a cert. Should either reject certs with non-zero minimum/non-absent maximum as MalformedCertificate, or at minimum document the omission.
title: GeneralSubtree minimum/maximum fields not validated (must be 0 and absent)
